d:
Amerika men hue mid tarm chunav men ripablikan parti ko har ka samna karna para. iske pichhe eeran men chhiri jang ko bhi ek bari vajah mana gaya. kya ab rashtrapti donald tranp eeran jang ko lekar alag rukh apnane ja rahe hain, kya unke prashasan men andar hi ab is mudde par ray bant gaee hai. dekhie yah vidiyo.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
